mentions.name: NoSpoilersClub
mentions.description: A web app for spoiler-free soccer replay watching. It uses a model to classify games by excitement and gives the viewer control over the level of spoilers shown, so they can pick the best games of the week to watch as replays.
mentions.problem: Too many soccer games are played each week for someone who can only watch replays, and browsing results risks spoilers that ruin the games.
mentions.audience: Too many soccer games are played each week for someone who can only watch replays, and browsing results risks spoilers that ruin the games.
